verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention or deletion controls: nothing on TTL policies, configurable retention windows, purging data or backups, log retention, or account and data deletion. The nearest items are adjacent features that do not give users control over retention: automated daily backups, point-in-time recovery and time travel (which keep data rather than delete it), disposable agent branches, and BYOC data residency. These earn no credit for this story.
